From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@compassai.com>

Cc: contracts@compassai.com, sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 8 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Production impact: elevated latency and 5xx errors — immediate remediation requested

Kimberly,

We're seeing a severe degradation in throughput and a sustained spike in 5xx errors from your hosted inference endpoint for our customer-facing product since ~08:40 PT. Key observations from our side: 
- Tail latency (p95/p99) ~3x normal for streaming requests
- Error rate jumped to ~10% (baseline <0.2%)
- Throughput dropped by ~40% for priority routes (model: rwd-base-32k)

This is causing page-timeouts for customers and automated retries are compounding load. Our engineering and ops teams are actively throttling reteies on our side to reduce pressure, but we need Redwood to: 
1) Provide immediate mitigation steps (capacity/burst/pinning/fallback)
2) Share a preliminary root-cause hypothesis and ETA for resolution
3) Confirm SLA breach exposure window and a calculation for credits/refund we should expect

I've attached a short screenshot of our monitoring window (error_spike_graph.png). We are available for an emergency call now — please loop in whoever owns commercial remediation and contracts.

We need a concrete mutual action plan by EOD Pacific. If this can't be resolved quickly, expect leadership escalation.

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Director of Engineering, Compass AI
S: +1 (415) 555-0199

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Production impact: elevated latency and 5xx errors — immediate remediation requested

Samantha / Compass team — thank you for the signal and for the graph. Apologies for the impact. Short summary of what we found and actions taken: 

What happened (prelim): 
- Between 08:30–09:10 PT on 2027-05-08 we saw a scheduler regression on the rwd-base-32k kernel selection path that degraded attention kernel throughput for long-context streaming requests. This increased p99 latency and led to cascading retries, producing the elevated 5xx rate you observed.

Immediate remediation (completed): 
- Rolled back the kernel selector to the previous stable commit at 09:12 PT.
- Applied a temporary capacity burst and pinned a subset of requests for Compass to dedicated workers to reduce noisy neighbor effects.
- Instituted a transient fallback to rwd-base-16k for priority routes where appropriate (configurable per route).

Current status: 
- Error rate down to 0.6% and trending toward baseline; p99 latency reduced ~1.7x from peak but still slightly elevated for a small tail segment. Ops remains on watch.

Preliminary credit proposal (subject to final accounting): 
- Offer: 25% credit on impacted API usage for the window 2027-05-08 08:30 PT — 2027-05-08 09:30 PT. This is our recommended commercial remediation for an SLA tier 2 breach (we can detail the math).
- Next steps: we will provide a completed SLA_calculation_sheet.xlsx with token counts and exact credit amount by EOD today. Legal redline for the MSA amendment attached for your review (Compass_MSA_redline_v2.pdf).

Proposed meeting: 10:30 PT today for a 30m exec/tech sync to finalize the remediation and timeline. If the Compass legal team prefers, we can route the MSA redline through your counsel first.
